evidence: An X-ray reﬂectivity (XRR) curve recorded using synchrotron radiation (Fig. 1) reveals a periodic oscillation stemming from a homogeneous single ﬁlm of 138 nm thickness on the substrate. The XRR data attest to the smoothness of the ﬁlm, with an estimated root mean square (rms) roughness below 1 nm. The GIXRD images a, d) reveal the transformation from the structure of NiO to that of metallic Ni.
